|game_text=Deploy on Sidious. While at Senate, if battle was just initiated anywhere, opponent must relocate this card to their participating character; during battle here, your destiny draws may not be canceled. If character about to be lost, relocate to Sidious; may ▲ a card.
|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[An Enemy Of The Republic (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). The images here, the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-D-anenemyoftherepublic-pre.gif]]) and the Virtual Block 5 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-15-An_Enemy_Of_The_Republic.png]]), show this text.
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 5 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009; slip [[:File:VB5-15-An_Enemy_Of_The_Republic.png]]): “Deploy on Sidious. While at Senate, if battle was just initiated anywhere, opponent must relocate this card to their participating character; during battle here, your destiny draws may not be canceled. If character about to be lost, relocate to Sidious; may ▲ a card.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock5">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-D-anenemyoftherepublic-pre.gif]]) prints the same text. The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again. That copy is a stale reprint, not a version (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[An Enemy Of The Republic (Errata)]]): adds “non-droid” and changes “a card” to “any one card”: “Deploy on Sidious. While at Senate, if battle was just initiated anywhere, opponent must relocate this card to their participating non-droid character; during battle here, your destiny draws may not be canceled. If character about to be lost, relocate to Sidious; may ▲ any one card.” Shown on the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013), which writes the ▲ out as “take any one card into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”<ref name="cl-1250_18-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>. No published card image prints this text; the image on [[An Enemy Of The Republic (Errata)]] is a CardMaker recreation.
